# Medical Imaging Agents: Comparison and Evidence

[Main collection](../README.md) · [Monthly brief](briefs/2026-11.md) · [Review protocol](review-protocol.md) · [Structured annotations](../data/comparison.yml)

20 selected works · Last source check: **2026-11-17**.

Selected for coverage of agent mechanisms, imaging settings, and evaluation designs. This is an editorial reading guide, not a leaderboard or an exhaustive survey. Training, data, tools, budgets, and outcome definitions differ across papers; their headline scores should not be ranked together.

Evidence labels describe the evaluated setting, not a quality grade. Expert review of retrospective outputs does not establish prospective clinical benefit. Controls marked as not audited remain unknown; absence of a verified control here does not mean the authors omitted it.

**Resource audit:** “Source inspected” means the public repository tree and/or README were retrieved and inspected. It does not establish complete data, weights, licensing, installability, or reproducibility. “Not established” means the inspected sources did not establish an implementation link. No model, dataset download, environment installation, or paper reproduction was attempted for this edition. All independent reproduction statuses are **not run**.

## Compare workflows

### Tool orchestration and segmentation

| Work | Task | Agent mechanism | Training | Evaluation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MedRAX](#medrax) | CXR reasoning | Multimodal controller selects specialist CXR tools. | No additional agent training. | ChestAgentBench: 2,500 queries in seven categories. |
| [MMedAgent](#mmedagent) | Multimodal tool selection | Instruction-tuned model chooses specialist medical tools. | Instruction tuning covering six tools, seven tasks, five modalities. | Tool selection and medical-task experiments. |
| [MedSAM-Agent](#medsam-agent) | Interactive segmentation | Agent issues and refines prompts to segmentation tools over multiple turns. | Expert trajectories followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning with outcome and process rewards. | 21 datasets across six modalities. |
| [VoxelPrompt](#voxelprompt) | Volumetric analysis | Language agent generates executable code calling a jointly trained volumetric vision network. | Language and vision components jointly trained from scratch. | Neuroimaging segmentation, morphology and lesion characterization. |
| [Taurus](#taurus) | Aortic CT annotation | Automated aortic labels plus targeted multiple-choice review of flagged errors. | Harness refinement; a new trained controller is not established from abstract. | Six public CT datasets, 939 volumes; refined system evaluated on 38 held-out cases. |

### Specialty and image-grounded workflows

| Work | Task | Agent mechanism | Training | Evaluation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [EndoCogniAgent](#endocogniagent) | Endoscopic diagnosis | Planner acquires visual evidence; consistency validation governs state updates and re-examination. | Agent workflow; controller training requirements not established from inspected abstract. | EndoAgentBench: 6,132 QA pairs from 11 endoscopy datasets; blinded clinician grading. |
| [PathLoop](#pathloop) | WSI/omics analysis | Visual/omics agents collect multi-scale evidence; judge triggers re-examination; memory reuses experience. | Framework with four-level memory; controller training not established from abstract. | Four TCGA cohorts: biomarker prediction, survival and subtype classification. |
| [SMILE](#smile) | Liver ultrasound reporting | Image, clinical-stage and VQA specialists feed a judge-guided consensus. | Specialist LoRA adapters documented in repository. | Public and internal liver ultrasound datasets. |
| [Dx-Rx](#dx-rx) | Brain MRI restoration | Measures artifacts, chooses restoration tools, checks repairs and can roll back. | Existing MLLMs orchestrate diagnostic and repair tools. | 148 T1 brain MRI volumes with simulated artifact mixtures calibrated to radiologist grades. |
| [MammoSeek](#mammoseek) | Mammography reporting | Global impression followed by selective zoom on detector candidates and BI-RADS-guided reporting. | Agent plus image-model decision layer; controller training not established from abstract. | EMBED internal and VinDr-Mammo external retrospective datasets. |

### Reporting and research pipelines

| Work | Task | Agent mechanism | Training | Evaluation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ARIVE](#arive) | CXR report generation | Requests anatomical visual observations between reasoning steps before final report composition. | SFT on 159,416 trajectories followed by anatomical and clinical-content GRPO rewards. | MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-ABN; blinded grading and paired error review. |
| [RadStructAgent](#radstructagent) | Report structuring | Orchestrator selects findings/anatomy judges, revision and candidate selection. | Qwen3-4B/8B prompted workflow; agent fine-tuning not established in abstract. | 1,000 free-text CXR reports; separate 97K-sample, 10-institution report-supervision experiment. |
| [MedGenAgent](#medgenagent) | CT pretraining data | Orchestrator and memory coordinate CT synthesis, VLM quality checks and model pretraining. | Synthetic pretraining then alignment using 4,400 DeepLesion samples. | 11,000 retained synthetic volumes; three retrospective downstream tasks. |
| [AMDagent](#amdagent) | Longitudinal AMD support | Quantitative retinal imaging tools and guideline retrieval ground longitudinal recommendations. | Tool-augmented clinical agent; new controller training not established from abstract. | 20 curated longitudinal AMD cases; expert-adjudicated support units and claim-grounding audit. |
| [MMedAgent-Plus](#mmedagent-plus) | Multimodal tool workflows | Vision-language planner sequences 18 specialists across 12 tasks and eight modalities. | Instruction tuning on 208,928 samples from 32 public benchmarks. | Separate orchestration, supplied-tool-output synthesis and 350 end-to-end cases. |

### Benchmarks and reliability

| Work | Task | Agent mechanism | Training | Evaluation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [NIBench](#nibench) | Neuroimaging research evaluation | Environment evaluates execution, workflow reconstruction, skill transfer and scientific judgment. | 19 model agents evaluated; selected agents receive distilled procedural skills. | 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems plus 36 Alzheimer research claims. |
| [ScienceVision](#sciencevision) | Scientific 3D reasoning evaluation | Agent harness exposes native 3D files, code tools and optional MCP inspection/measurement. | Evaluation of 12 models; no new agent training described in abstract. | 250 questions across five domains, including 50 medical imaging questions. |
| [MedImageOSWorld](#medimageosworld) | Acquisition-console evaluation | GUI agents operate simulated CT/MR/ultrasound consoles with screenshots and mouse/keyboard. | Evaluation harness; new agent training not established from abstract. | Seven capability levels; separate workflow checks and hidden anatomy-based outcomes. |
| [ABRA](#abra) | Radiology workstation evaluation | OHIF and Orthanc exposed through 21 navigation, annotation and reporting tools. | Ten models evaluated; no new controller training required by benchmark description. | 655 generated tasks from three public CT/MRI collections. |
| [MedScope-4B](#medscope-4b) | Evidence sensitivity / abstention | Shared zoom/window loop with answer, refer and clarify actions; counterfactual evidence training. | Supervised and rejection-sampling fine-tuning on label-derived edited-image trajectories. | 507 internal cases; external centers and fresh pneumothorax test. |

## Evidence and resource ledger

### MedRAX

**MedRAX: Medical Reasoning Agent for Chest X-ray**

- Primary source: [v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02673v2).
- Evidence setting: Offline benchmark. ChestAgentBench: 2,500 queries in seven categories.
- Control evidence checked: Comparisons with open and proprietary models reported; matched tool budgets not established from abstract.
- Interpretation / limit: Benchmark accuracy does not establish patient-care benefit.
- Code audit: [Source inspected](https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedRAX). Public README and source tree inspected; medrax/, benchmark/ and quickstart.py present. API credentials and specialist assets remain execution prerequisites.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract; repository README and root tree.
- Resource snapshot: `README.md` blob SHA `4673f103df5ddf933bebddcbd92f76a6ed849032` (recorded from the public source tree; not a release or execution hash).

### MMedAgent

**MMedAgent: Learning to Use Medical Tools with Multi-modal Agent**

- Primary source: [v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02483v2).
- Evidence setting: Offline benchmark. Tool selection and medical-task experiments.
- Control evidence checked: Open-model and GPT-4o comparisons reported; full matched-backbone attribution not audited.
- Interpretation / limit: Five modalities and seven tasks are distinct; the older catalog description conflated them.
- Code audit: [Source inspected](https://github.com/Wangyixinxin/MMedAgent). Public README, tool table, training/inference entry points and source tree inspected. Base-model, tool-weight and data downloads were not tested.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract; repository README and root tree.
- Resource snapshot: `README.md` blob SHA `7d707b656c5751ae06bce81ef345432a9b77a02b` (recorded from the public source tree; not a release or execution hash).

### VoxelPrompt

**VoxelPrompt: A Vision Agent for End-to-End Medical Image Analysis**

- Primary source: [v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08397v2).
- Evidence setting: Offline benchmark. Neuroimaging segmentation, morphology and lesion characterization.
- Control evidence checked: Specialist-model comparisons reported; ablation section exists, but individual control results not audited.
- Interpretation / limit: Evidence is centered on neuroimaging; do not infer validation on every volumetric modality.

- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract and full-text implementation section.

### Taurus

**Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost**

- Primary source: [v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00247v2).
- Evidence setting: Offline benchmark. Six public CT datasets, 939 volumes; refined system evaluated on 38 held-out cases.
- Control evidence checked: Free-form coding-agent comparison; initial model review and later automation are distinguished.
- Interpretation / limit: Most reported gain comes from harness automation; final held-out set is much smaller than initial dataset pool.
- Code audit: Implementation link not established in inspected sources. No implementation link established in the inspected paper abstract; this is not a claim that code does not exist.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract.

### Dx-Rx

**Measure Before You Repair: An Explainable Agent for Blind Restoration of Multi-Artifact 3-D MRI**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03996v1).
- Evidence setting: Simulated corruptions on real volumes. 148 T1 brain MRI volumes with simulated artifact mixtures calibrated to radiologist grades.
- Control evidence checked: Image-only agent, same-tool expert rules and ground-truth-artifact oracle comparisons.
- Interpretation / limit: Radiologist-calibrated corruption is still simulation; clinical mixed-artifact restoration is not established.
- Code audit: [Source inspected](https://github.com/itu-biai/measure-before-you-repair). README and root tree inspected: src/, configs/, splits/, tests/ and uv.lock present. IXI data, weights and model API access were not downloaded or executed.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract; repository README and root tree.
- Resource snapshot: `README.md` blob SHA `a4c0c0772dae4c879f4ce091681a200c0b09e82f` (recorded from the public source tree; not a release or execution hash).

### MammoSeek

**MammoSeek: A Mammography Agent with selective zooming for grounded reports**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07188v1).
- Evidence setting: Retrospective internal + external datasets. EMBED internal and VinDr-Mammo external retrospective datasets.
- Control evidence checked: Selective versus no zoom and forced zoom comparisons reported.
- Interpretation / limit: External retrospective evaluation is stronger than a single internal test, but does not establish prospective recall benefit.
- Code audit: Implementation link not established in inspected sources. No implementation link established in the inspected paper abstract; this is not a claim that code does not exist.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract.

### ARIVE

**Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14018v1).
- Evidence setting: Offline benchmark + expert review. MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-ABN; blinded grading and paired error review.
- Control evidence checked: Paired review with/without trajectories; anatomical and clinical reward ablations described.
- Interpretation / limit: More detected report errors came with longer review time; inspectable reasoning is not automatically faithful.
- Code audit: [Source inspected](https://github.com/DUTIR-BioNLP/ARIVE). README and public tree inspected: data_generation/, inference/, qwenvl/ and scripts/ present. Credentialed MIMIC access, model downloads and GPU execution were not tested.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract and full-text methods/code availability; repository README and tree.
- Resource snapshot: `README.md` blob SHA `0fc149bb9853ab81c0172d9f75a8a0674769ace9` (recorded from the public source tree; not a release or execution hash).

### NIBench

**NIBench: benchmarking autonomous AI agents for execution, skill evolution and scientific judgment in neuroimaging**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15831v1).
- Evidence setting: Research workflow benchmark. 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems plus 36 Alzheimer research claims.
- Control evidence checked: Supplied versus withheld protocols and skill transfer to unseen tasks/models.
- Interpretation / limit: Reproducible outputs can support expert-inconsistent conclusions; task completion and judgment are separate outcomes.

### ScienceVision

**ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04087v1).
- Evidence setting: Cross-domain benchmark. 250 questions across five domains, including 50 medical imaging questions.
- Control evidence checked: Native artifacts with/without added MCP tools versus rendered-image inputs; deterministic scoring.
- Interpretation / limit: Overall benchmark averages include nonmedical domains; do not present them as medical-only performance.

**MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04800v1).

### ABRA

**ABRA: Agent Benchmark for Radiology Applications**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11224v1).

### MedScope-4B

**Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows**

- Primary source: [v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13006v1).
- Evidence setting: Counterfactual internal + external tests. 507 internal cases; external centers and fresh pneumothorax test.
- Control evidence checked: Lesion erasure/control edits, training ablations and removal-based DPO comparison.
- Interpretation / limit: Lower erased-lesion claims coexist with missed real disease: 0/48 pneumothorax detections in fresh external testing.
- Code audit: [Source inspected](https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/medscope). README and root tree inspected: medscope/, configs/, scripts/ and tests/ present. Models, data recipes and reported results were not independently run.
- Independent reproduction: **not run**. Checked 2026-11-17; scope: Paper abstract and full-text protocol/training sections; repository README and tree.
